SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.: 74.........
File No............. 4.3.29

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
Foreign Section, C.I.D.
March 4, 1929.

Korean Meeting

About 350 local Koreans including several Korean
revolutionary leaders, a few who are Nationalist army
officials in uniform and some Formosan students assembled
in the Baptist Church, Boulevard des Deux Republiques,
French Town at 2 p.m. March I, on the occasion of the
Tenth Anniversary of the Declaration of Korean Independence.
Mr. Kwak Hun(郭憲), Chairman of the Korean Club,
No. I Yah Chung Li(協成里) Rue Brenier de Montmorand,
French Town, took the chair and delivered the opening
speech in which he urged the audience to celebrate in a
religious spirit and with bitter hearts the day of March
I as the birth-day of Korean Independence with the freedom
of Koreans still in the hands of the Japanese. Mr. Kim
Ku(金九), Chairman of the Finance Committee of the
Korean Provisional Government, read the Declaration of the
Korean Independence. Messrs Cho So Ang(趙素昂), Ex-
Foreign Minister of the Korean Provisional Government, and
Cho Wan Ku(趙晚九), Ex-Senator of the Senate of the Korean
Provisional Government, addressed the audience in similar
strain and urged those present to propagate a strong
revolutionary spirit amongst Koreans and endeavour to rid
Korea of all Japanese. These members were followed by
a Formosan student named Li who in the course of his
address advocated the retrocession of Korean territory
from the militaristic and atrocious Japanese. He also
advised his listeners to bring to a successful realization
the revolution in Korea and Formosa. The chairman Kwak
read one congratulatory letter from the local Indian
Association in which it was mentioned that the members
of the association hope for Korean Independence as well
as Indian Independence because they are brothers in the

朝鲜人集会

约350名在沪朝鲜人，其中包括数名朝鲜革命领袖、几名身着制服的国民党军队官员以及一些台湾学生，于3月1日下午2时，在法租界双共和路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques）的浸信会教堂集会，纪念《朝鲜独立宣言》发表十周年。
朝鲜俱乐部主席郭宪（Kwak Hun）先生主持了会议，该俱乐部位于法租界孟德兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）协成里1号。他在开幕致辞中敦促听众以宗教般的虔诚和沉痛的心情庆祝3月1日这一天，将其视为朝鲜独立的诞辰，尽管朝鲜人的自由仍掌握在日本人手中。朝鲜临时政府财政委员会主席金九（Kim Ku）先生宣读了《朝鲜独立宣言》。朝鲜临时政府前外长赵素昂（Cho So Ang）先生和朝鲜临时政府参议院前议员赵晚九（Cho Wan Ku）先生发表了类似基调的演讲，敦促在场者在朝鲜人中传播强烈的革命精神，并努力清除在朝鲜的所有日本人。随后，一位姓李的台湾学生发言，主张从军国主义且残暴的日本手中收回朝鲜领土。他还建议听众致力于成功实现朝鲜和台湾的革命。主席郭宪宣读了一封来自本地印度协会的贺信，信中提及该协会成员希望朝鲜独立以及印度独立，因为他们处于

page_data.en:
Summary translation of circulars distributed amongst
Koreans in the Baptist Church, Boulevard des deux
Republiques, French Town, on March I, 1929.
-- ----------

Written declaration issued on the Tenth Anniversary
of the Declaration of the Independence of Korea.
On March I, 1919 the dying children of Korea oppressed
under the iron heel of Japan, declared their independence
and clamoured with tears and blood for freedom. Since
then March I has passed every year with unspeakable
shame because we have done nothing to bring about the
success of our independence movement. We celebrate the
Tenth Anniversary to-day. What have we fought for
during these ten years? The imperialist Japanese still
oppress the Koreans. However do not be discouraged.
It is true that we Koreans are poor and have not enough
power to fight against the Japanese but there are many
changes because the dissensions between the Japanese
capitalists and laboureres, the Japanese and European
imperialists, and the Japanese imperialists and the
world revolutionists will bring about the downfall of
Japan sooner or later. This will be the chance for us
Koreans. Such a chance will be of no use to us if
we do not make preparations to utilise it. We hope firstly
that all Koreans will sacrifice their personal opinion
and disregard partial difference so as to unite together
and create a strong front against the Japanese.
Secondly, we should not rely upon another nation for
assistance in connection with our independence movement,
but must trust only our death-dealing daggers, pistols
and bombs, because we failed to receive any redress
at the Paris and Washington Conferences. We want
real independence. We don't want Korea to be autonomous
or a self-government or even a Free State. We must
continue our destructive work with greater force and
form mass organizations based on the labourers in order
to make our revolution a success.
Our slogans are as follows:-
Celebrate March 1st.!
Revenge yourselves for our fellow countrymen who
sacrificed their lives in the struggle!
Down with imperialist Japan!
Kill all Koreans who want to compromise with Japan!
Revolutionize the agrarian question!
Long live Korea's Independence!
Long live the world revolution!

Issued by the Central Committee of Korean Righteous
Party.

----------

Other five circulars were issued by the Korean Young
Men's Association in Shanghai, Korean Independence Party,
Korean Young Women's Club, Korean Young Men's Association
in Nanking, and All organizations in Shanghai.
The contents of these five circulars resemble the
preceeding one.

1929年3月1日在法租界双共和路浸信会教堂
向朝鲜人分发的传单摘要译文。
-- ----------

发表于朝鲜独立宣言十周年之际的书面宣言。
1919年3月1日，在日本铁蹄压迫下奄奄一息的朝鲜儿女宣布独立，并用血泪呐喊争取自由。此后，每年的3月1日都在难以言喻的耻辱中度过，因为我们未能为独立运动的成功做任何事情。今天我们庆祝十周年纪念日。在这十年里，我们为之奋斗了什么？帝国主义日本仍然压迫着朝鲜人。然而，不要气馁。的确，我们朝鲜人贫穷，没有足够的力量与日本人对抗，但局势正在发生许多变化，因为日本资本家与劳工之间、日本与欧洲帝国主义者之间、以及日本帝国主义者与世界革命者之间的分歧迟早会导致日本的垮台。这将是我们朝鲜人的机会。如果我们不做好准备加以利用，这样的机会对我们毫无用处。首先，我们希望所有朝鲜人牺牲个人意见，忽略局部差异，以便团结起来，建立对抗日本的强大阵线。
其次，在独立运动方面，我们不应依赖其他国家的援助，而必须只信赖我们要命的匕首、手枪和炸弹，因为我们在巴黎和华盛顿会议上未能获得任何补救。我们要的是真正的独立。我们不想要朝鲜自治、自我管理，甚至是自由邦。我们必须以更大力度继续我们的破坏工作，并以劳工为基础组建群众组织，以使我们的革命取得成功。
我们的口号如下：-
庆祝三一节！
为在斗争中牺牲的同胞报仇！
打倒帝国主义日本！
杀死所有想与日本妥协的朝鲜人！
革命化土地问题！
朝鲜独立万岁！
世界革命万岁！

由朝鲜义烈团中央委员会发布。

----------

另外五份传单由上海朝鲜青年会、朝鲜独立党、朝鲜青年妇女俱乐部、南京朝鲜青年会以及上海各团体联合发布。
这五份传单的内容与前述一份相似。

庆祝三一节！

革命化土地问题！
朝鲜独立万岁！
